verdict.item: System scans local videos for faces and visible text/watermarks.
Face recognition is limited by the local known performer DB, currently one enrolled performer: Sava Schultz.
Most current model naming comes from OCR profile/watermark text, aliases, and user-confirmed registry cleanup.
No Yandex/private/browser/Coomer/PimpBunny web search runs during batch scanning today.
Only online provider hook is optional pAPI/RapidAPI with --online-metadata and PAPI_RAPIDAPI_KEY.
Report code now has manual Yandex/PimpBunny/Coomer text-verification links, but live HTML must be regenerated.

batch_flow.step: Load config, thresholds, known performer DB, and InsightFace model.
Find videos under source, excluding review/output/model/unknown/backup folders.
Skip fresh approved sidecars unless force; scan missing, stale, or verification-needed records.
Use ffprobe and ffmpeg to extract sampled frames.
Run InsightFace on frames; reject low-score or tiny faces.
Compare accepted face embeddings to local known_performers/embeddings.npy.
Classify face matches: auto if similarity >= 0.80, possible if >= 0.55, unknown otherwise.
Run OCR on full frame plus top/bottom/left/right watermark-heavy crops.
Parse profile handles and watermarks from OnlyFans, Fansly, Fanvue, stolen/leaked/from, and @handle text.
Filter host/repost/noise strings and normalize aliases.
Combine strong watermark/profile evidence with face agreement when possible.
Write .face-meta.json sidecar and review images when --apply.

verification_flow.does: Reads sidecars, canonicalizes aliases, rebuilds performer_verification.json, writes model_index.json, organizes videos, removes empty model folders.
verification_flow.does_not: Does not scan new frames and does not search Yandex/Coomer/PimpBunny/web.

statuses.status: Trusted profile handle extracted from watermark/profile text.
Local face DB auto match exists.

organize_flow.side_effects: Moves video, .face-meta.json, optional .nfo; updates embedded paths; writes organize_manifest.json.

report_flow.shows: Only verification_needed records; embeds review frames and crops; shows badges, metadata hints, actions.
report_flow.new_patch: Renders manual Yandex, Yandex site:pimpbunny.com, Yandex site:coomer.st, and Coomer links for top OCR candidates.

sample_407017.interpretation: No usable face crop in report; best next path is text/watermark verification and improved OCR variants.

important_files.file: Main scan, OCR, face match, sidecar, registry, organization, report code.

boundaries.item: Do not perform internet face recognition or compare local faces to web images.
Use text watermarks, profile URLs, handles, filenames, local sidecars, and user corrections.
Do not let host/repost sites become model names.

patch_targets.target: Regenerate live report so verifier links appear.
Add text-only web evidence schema to sidecars and registry.
Add provider abstraction for Yandex URL generation, Coomer text/profile lookup, PimpBunny site-scoped query, and user-provided sites.
Improve OCR candidate variants, dedupe, and scoring.
Add model-index audit report for auto/profile-url records.
Build confirmed-crop enrollment workflow to grow known_performers safely.
